notes: Bar Jonah heads on Jonah under rule 66's compound arm; heading on Bar remains defensible since the ASV splits one source token into two.
who is in heaven: who goes to the second article and is in to the preposition, per rule 31's verbless-modifier clause, the article following its noun and so keeping only the relativizer.
τοῖς is unrepresented because the ASV writes heaven without a determiner (rules 21, 23).
